title: Portable JSON admission
responsibility: Checks whether values can retain their meaning across supported JSON runtimes within the nesting bound.

inputs.name: portableJson.value
inputs.description: Value to inspect: finite numbers, well-formed strings, booleans, null, arrays and plain/null-prototype objects are supported. Undefined object fields are ignored; unsupported values are refused.

inputs.name: portableJson.level
inputs.description: Current container nesting depth, default zero; recursive calls advance it.

outputs.name: portableJson
outputs.description: True when inspected values pass numeric, Unicode, prototype and depth checks; false otherwise. Input is checked in place rather than cloned or serialized.

outputs.name: notPortable
outputs.description: Shared runtime failure with code invalid-json and message request is not valid JSON.
